## Signed in (new account, 2026-10-31)
- recalculated after login (the login drops the filled form); "+ Add PO No." under the assembly fields (new)
- cookie notice: only "Cookie Preferences" | "Accept All" – closed with its X
- "Save to Cart" opens a dialog "Special Notes": "Please ensure your uploaded files do not contain: Parts subject to export control
  regulations such as ITAR, EAR, or EU Dual Use; Content that is illegal, offensive, or violates intellectual property rights;
  Military, weapon-related, or controlled end-use items; FCC Rule 2&-50 applies if you apply for a NEW FCC ID for finished product
  using this PCBA …" – buttons Cancel | Agree. A declaration in the owner's name: the skill stops and asks (the owner agreed for the test board).
- new account: "Email Verification" dialog before the cart (send code to the account mail) – the owner's
- cart (member.pcbway.com/Order/CartList): two lines per board – "x Layers, Size …" PCB line ([PCB Production]) and "Assembly for PCB No."

  [Centroid Template file -> a-sample-of-PCBWay-Centroid-File.txt] | "Upload assembly other files" (.pdf too) [Assembly Instruction Drawing];

  – not submitted (no review started)

  the xlsx template's exact headers not read (would need a download)
- the assembly price excludes components until the review
- test item left in the cart (2 lines, $34 incl. order discount) – the owner deletes it
- Terms of Service (https://www.pcbway.com/terms_service.html, "Effective as of Oct 22, 2026"), read 2026-10-31: no clause on automated
